name: a ticket re-run after its PR was closed unmerged with an outside-code lesson
description: A class was missing from the site because its term isn't available on the web in the booking system. The first run hardcoded the program id into a force-active list; people closed that PR unmerged. A second run (started by a field change on the ticket) reused the old plan, opened the same override again, and only then learned the fix belongs in the booking system. A third trigger on the unchanged ticket must not open another PR, whatever the planner says.

runs.lesson: When a class is missing from the site schedule, check whether its term is marked available on the web in the booking system before changing code.

plan.cause: The class is inactive because its term is not available on the web.
plan.history_check: Forcing the program active is the quickest way to show the class.
